meta.title: LLC Book 2 · 第五课 秋天快到了
meta.subtitle: Autumn Is Almost Here · Interactive Workbook

dialogue: 你看！树叶变黄了，秋天快到了。
Look! The leaves are turning yellow. Autumn is almost here.
nǐ kàn! shù yè biàn huáng le, qiū tiān kuài dào le.
But the grass is still green.
kě shì cǎo hái shì lǜ sè de.
秋天天气很好。我觉得很舒服。
The weather is nice in autumn. I feel comfortable.
qiū tiān tiān qì hěn hǎo. wǒ jué de hěn shū fu.
春天的时候，我们家院子有很多颜色的花，红色的、白色的都有。
In spring, our yard has flowers of many colors, including red and white.
chūn tiān de shí hou, wǒ men jiā yuàn zi yǒu hěn duō yán sè de huā, hóng sè de, bái sè de dōu yǒu.
我觉得红色的花最漂亮。
I think red flowers are the prettiest.
wǒ jué de hóng sè de huā zuì piào liang.
